{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crystal Valley pumping station''' was a [[Water/Legends|water]] pumping station in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Crystal Valley (Nam Chorios)|Crystal Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. In [[44 ABY]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]], who had achieved control over the native [[Theran Listener]]s [[The Force/Legends|Force]] organization, drew the Listners there and began feeding off of them. However, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and their friend, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] tracked Abeloth there and [[Operation Shieldfall|confronted]] her. Luke defeated Abeloth, [[Mnemotherapy|tearing]] the spirit of the Jedi Knight [[Callista Ming]]&mdash;whom Abeloth had consumed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] previously&mdash;from Abeloth. The [[Master of the Theran Listeners]], [[Nenn]], who had also fallen under Abeloth's control, then committed suicide, further weakening Abeloth. As she fled, however, a group of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] led by [[Sith Saber]] [[Tola Annax]] attacked the Jedi in the pumping station, but Khai killed a [[tsil]]&mdash;a native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]&mdash;creating a massive [[death convulsion]] that allowed them to flee from the Sith.
